We need to determine appropriate charge(s) for the given facts.

Facts: Ma pretended to be a staff of transportation management office, used false documents (salary proof, unit seal, property, vehicle registration) to obtain a bank loan of 200,000 RMB. Loan not repaid, but later family repaid. The prosecution says loan fraud (贷款诈骗罪). The list includes "贷款诈骗" as a charge label. Also possibly "伪造、变造、买卖国家机关公文、证件、印章" because he used false documents, but the main charge is loan fraud. In examples, they used "贷款诈骗" for similar scenario. So answer: [罪名]贷款诈骗<eoa>. No other charges.

Thus final answer JSON with reasoning and final answer.
